acceptanceCriteria.text: Capture identifies a target mobId and its exact normal/PvP predefined squad at supported levels.
Account/map-scoped detail extraction and dialog select the exact preset while preserving dual-preset fallback for unknown targets.

checkpointPayload.description: Future enhancement to @task-VHE-ZP1CW2: solo search replies in the available capture omit variant/config/preset identity, so the dialog intentionally shows both level presets. Needs a game capture connecting target mobId to authoritative mobConfigId/predefinedSquadId for normal/PvP targets, and a verified config mapping if only config ID is supplied. CDN globalMapMobSolo was unreachable during implementation. Do not infer numeric mapping or send guessed detail RPCs.
checkpointPayload.title: Capture exact solo monster target variant identity for power comparison
